title: Cloud Connector on AWS: what is deployed and where each question is answered
aliases: asg and non-asg in same vpc

prose.text: {{purpose}} {{ami-marketplace}} Zscaler's Terraform module defaults describe a reference implementation, not product requirements, unless a Help claim says the same.

prose.label: Two IaC paths.
prose.text: {{iac-paths}} Each deployment type needs its own template family, [[cloud-connector.overview.groups:template-match]], and {{template-family-rule}} CloudFormation is covered in [[cloud-connector.aws.cloudformation]] and the Terraform modules in [[cloud-connector.aws.reference-modules]].

prose.label: Elsewhere.
prose.text: Workload discovery and sublocation scopes are in [[cloud-connector.workload-discovery]]; group-level HA, tunnel failover and upgrade windows in [[cloud-connector.overview]]; the Zscaler-managed AWS and GCP gateways are a different product path, see [[cloud-connector.gcp-ztg]].

purpose.statement: Cloud Connector makes cloud workloads follow organizational security policy for public and private destinations by forwarding their traffic to ZIA and ZPA, and is available as a virtual appliance in AWS and Azure.

quotes: Zscaler Cloud Connector ensures that cloud workloads adhere to organizational security policy when accessing both public and private endpoints. This is achieved by intelligently forwarding traffic to the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platforms.
It is available as a virtual appliance in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure

ami-marketplace.statement: On AWS, Cloud Connector is deployed as an Amazon Machine Image and requires a subscription to Zscaler Cloud Connector in the commercial or China AWS Marketplace.

quotes: how to deploy Zscaler Cloud Connector as an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) on Amazon Web Services (AWS)
You have a subscription to Zscaler Cloud Connector in the AWS Marketplace.

iac-paths.statement: AWS deployment templates exist as CloudFormation and as Terraform (Azure and GCP have Terraform only); the Terraform templates deploy into a new or existing VPC.

quotes: AWS deployment templates are available in CloudFormation and Terraform repositories. Azure and GCP deployment templates are available in Terraform repositories.
Use the templates in the Terraform repository to create the deployment resources required to deploy and operate Cloud Connector in a new or existing VPC.

template-family-rule.statement: On AWS, autoscaling and non-autoscaling Cloud Connector deployments must not run in the same VPC.

quotes: Additionally, do not run both ASG and non-ASG deployments within the same Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).
